answer: Price identity creation by congestion: the bond to register the n-th key from one funding root inside a 20-epoch window is 50*2^(n-1) POA. One honest newcomer pays 50; a farm minting 10 keys in that window pays 50+100+200+...+25600 = 51,150 POA. Each funding root is a vertex in the registration graph, so a whole garden of aliases planted on one terrace of funding is exactly the burst this curve punishes, while a slow honest trickle of single registrations stays cheap.
